### Fixed
- **The LLM listener attributes a kagent API v2 agent's model calls to the agent, not to the Substrate egress** (giantswarm/agent-platform#586). `gateway.metricLabels`' `agent` and `agent_namespace` were the source workload resolved by IP (`source.unverifiedWorkload.serviceAccount` / `.namespace`), the shape of kagent 0.10 — one Deployment and one ServiceAccount per agent. Under kagent API v2 an agent is an `AgentTemplate` executed as a Substrate actor in the shared WorkerPool, and every actor connection leaves the worker as a mTLS CONNECT through the Substrate egress (`atenet-egress`), which authenticates the actor at CONNECT time and tunnels the bytes opaquely: by source IP every agent's model call was the egress pod, every agent's spend one row named after a proxy, and `user` `unknown` (actor traffic carries no bearer). The egress cannot add a header. The kagent runtime sends the identity on every model call as request headers — `x-kagent-agent` and `x-kagent-agent-namespace` (the template's name and namespace) and `x-kagent-user` (the person of the turn) — and the three default expressions read them when, and only when, the source workload is the egress (`agent-platform.substrate.egressCall`: the namespace and ServiceAccount from the chart's Substrate names, `agent-platform.substrate.egressServiceAccount`); every other caller keeps its own ServiceAccount, so no pod relabels itself by sending the header, and a call from the egress without the header reads `unknown` — the egress ServiceAccount itself appears in no new sample. The identity stays an accounting identity, never an authorization input. Mirrored in the meta chart. `make verify-metric-labels` asserts the three expressions with the predicate and the header names (parsed, since `toYaml` folds a long expression across lines), the person label's hold and claim knob behind the predicate, an installation's own expression replacing the default, and the meta chart forwarding the expressions unrendered; `verify-target` holds the old expressions equal on both sides of its golden comparison until `origin/main` carries this. README "Metric labels". Installations act: none — the `-metrics` policy is re-rendered on the upgrade; the runtime half is the kagent line's carried patch, and until an installation runs it the egress row reads `unknown` instead of the egress ServiceAccount.
